stem_book: 2 mol of Hg(g) is combusted in a fixed volume bomb calorimeter with excess of O₂ at 298 K and 1 atm into HgO(s). During the reaction, temperature increases from 298.0 K to 312.8 K. The value of |X| is ______. [Given: Gas constant R = 8.3 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹]
